mod.name: Production Tuner
mod.description: Adjusts processing speeds, throughput, hydraulic rates and capacities for all machines, tools and vehicles.
Automatically scales dependent devices (hog pan, wave table, magnetite separator, trailers) to at least the bucket multiplier to prevent material loss.
config.group1_handtools.section: Group 1 - Hand Tools & Mobile Wash Plants

Maximum fill volume of the bucket (capped at maximum allowed dependent input capacity).
Maximum fill volume of the hog pan (scales with bucket).
